name: RE:START
shortDescription: A confident, progressive return to strength training after a long break.
description: RE:START rebuilds the movement patterns, work capacity, and confidence that make the gym feel like yours again. Every session includes clear coaching, easier and harder options, and a simple readiness check.
audience: For people who have been inactive, feel deconditioned, or want structure before returning to regular training.

lessons.title: Rebuild your squat
lessons.description: Find a comfortable range and rebuild lower-body control.

lessons.title: Push, pull, carry
lessons.description: A full-body strength circuit with scalable loading.

lessons.title: Capacity without chaos
lessons.description: Build work capacity at a pace you can repeat.

name: RE:TURN
shortDescription: Step-by-step strength and movement after back pain has settled.
description: RE:TURN helps you move past the uncertainty that can linger after back pain. Build trunk capacity, gradually reintroduce bending and lifting, and learn how to adjust a session without abandoning it.
audience: For people whose acute symptoms have improved and who are ready for a gradual, active return to exercise.

lessons.title: Find your starting point
lessons.description: A calm baseline session for trunk and hip control.

lessons.title: Bend with confidence
lessons.description: Explore comfortable hinging and lifting patterns.

lessons.title: Build your engine
lessons.description: Integrate strength and conditioning without chasing symptoms.

name: RE:GROW
shortDescription: Progressive loading, balance, and confidence for stronger bones and an active life.
description: RE:GROW makes evidence-informed strength and impact training approachable. Progress resistance, balance, and everyday power with clear options built around your current experience and comfort.
audience: For adults focused on osteopenia, osteoporosis, balance, or staying strong and capable as they age.

lessons.title: Strong foundations
lessons.description: Squat, row, and carry patterns with stable support options.

lessons.title: Load with purpose
lessons.description: Build strength using measurable, repeatable loads.

name: RE:BUILD
shortDescription: A future pathway for rebuilding capacity and returning to exercise after pregnancy.
description: A planned postpartum pathway built around gradual strength, impact readiness, and the realities of a changing schedule.
audience: For postpartum adults who have been appropriately cleared to resume exercise.

name: RE:FUEL
shortDescription: A future practical nutrition library for recovery, strength, and everyday energy.
description: A planned collection of flexible meal plans, preparation guides, and nutrition education developed with a qualified nutrition professional.
audience: For members who want practical nutrition structure alongside their movement plan.
